description: This Dart source file defines a class 'RideState' for managing ride-related state in a Flutter app. It uses ChangeNotifier for state management and provides getters and setters for ride details like distance, destination, and ride request status.

classes.name: RideState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing ride state information such as distance, destination, and ride requests within a Flutter application.

methods.name: setDistance
methods.description: Sets the trip distance and notifies listeners.

methods.name: requestRide
methods.description: Signals that a ride has been requested.

methods.name: setDestinationAddress
methods.description: Sets the destination address and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setDestinationCoords
methods.description: Sets the destination coordinates (latitude and longitude) and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setCurrentAddress
methods.description: Sets the current user address and notifies listeners.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all ride state values to initial defaults and notifies listeners.
